Name: (MG) DustBeauty's Wildflower Grass Field
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/KHeZcUB.gif[/img]
This is an updated version of the mod. This mod utilized purely the assets of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5407]original mod[/url].

Permission can be checked [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9139916]here[/url].

If you have any in-game issues or bugs, please ensure to include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi log[/url] (and image if applicable). Without info, I won't be able to help. 

[img]https://imgur.com/jOzny49.gif[/img]

1. Download the mod and its requirements 
2. Extract and put it inside your Mods folder
3. Launch the game

[img]https://imgur.com/rqbUyQF.gif[/img]

Credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9139916]Dustbeauty[/url]! I love her mods so much and it's been the first ones I use when I first played the game with mods.[/center]
